chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Hammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Hurayz, on the authority of Zurarah that Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
God, the Mighty and Majestic, has made incumbent thirty-five prayers from one Friday to the next. Among them is one prayer that God has made obligatory in congregation, and that is the Friday prayer.
ai.seo_question: How many obligatory prayers are there from Friday to Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the jurisprudential calculation of thirty-five obligatory prayers within a weekly cycle, emphasizing that the Friday prayer is the only one mandated to be performed in congregation (jamāʿah). This distinction underscores the communal dimension of worship in Shia fiqh, separating the individual daily obligations from the collective Friday ritual.
